## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · `target:v18` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). Unblocks #11509: the console pin moves past objectui `5bc55c0c5a1e`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T01:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in this repo's `.objectui-sha` and the build it derives ⇒ `domain:devx`, the lane of the earlier bumps (#21996, #21807). It uses the repo's own procedure, as PR #22015 did.

- **Why it queues:** it is the ordering that ruling `6051498447` sets on #11509 ("the spec retirement ships with the pin bump that carries it"). It is a product change, since the bundled Console ships, so it is not a tooling card. It unblocks #11509, which is open and dispatched; that PR stays a held draft until this lands.
- **Why p3 and v18:** the same grade as the card it unblocks.
- **What it carries:** objectui `5bc55c0c5a1e` (objectui#11880's closing merge) and everything between that and today's pin, about 160 objectui commits. The PR lists the user-visible changes the bump brings into the Console from that range, and any gate it moves.
- ⛔ Not a release act. The Version Packages PR #21988 is untouched.
- **Cloud is separate.** Cloud pins objectui itself (`.objectui-sha` `f1781be3`). Its move past objectui#11880 is the row #11509's landing adds to objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 (my unlock note `6071460039`).

Claim: PM loop round 4
Session: `session_0115N1oNnQS5WqofZ2DzaT3q`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22385-objectui-pin-bump`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22385`
Domain: `domain:devx`
Seat: `domain:devx#1`
File surface: one console pin bump, by the repo's own procedure (`scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, then `pnpm objectui:build`, then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`). It lands `.objectui-sha` at objectui `main` as read at the run's start, and that pin must contain `5bc55c0c5a1e`. It also writes the script's `@objectstack/console` changeset; `sdui.manifest.json` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`; and `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`. Under `packages/spec/src/**` it touches only the citation sites that `check:objectui-pin-citations` and `check:sdui-lockstep` name, as comment and describe text with no schema shape change, plus a pin-citation changeset if those sites ship. It regenerates `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` through `gen:migration-registry`, and any `content/docs/references/**` page `check:generated --fix` rewrites. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus — the default tier; dispatch-gates --tier: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Ruling-ref: `6051498447` (on #11509, sub-question 2: "objectui first (…), and the spec retirement ships with the pin bump that carries it")
Thread-read: 6072636718
Serial constraints cleared: `.objectui-sha` is a single-claim path, and no open PR writes it (14 open PRs' file lists read). No open PR touches `component.zod.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `sdui.manifest.json` or the lockstep file. `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is also written by PR #22380 and PR #22315 (both `domain:spec` drafts); it is generated, so whichever lands later regenerates it. #11509 (`domain:spec` seat 2) edits the element-layer records in `component.zod.ts` after this lands, in the ruling's order. Seat 2's `area:devpath` claims #22014 and #22085 are file-disjoint from this surface. Contract review: the diff will reach `packages/spec/src/**` (non-test), so an at-tier review is owed before enqueue — read at 2026-10-09T02:17Z
